name: kids_game
use_case: Kids learning app / game voice turns: profanity, insults, threats, self-harm, grooming, PII, jailbreak
description: Short spoken turns of children talking to an in-game character. Domain kids: thresholds fitted on kid turns plus the guard layer (profanity, insult and threat as utterance safety tags; PII tags need evidence in the words; backstops for self-harm, grooming, sexual content and jailbreak). Set command_context on while the child is on a command screen so cockpit commands ("kill the heaters") are never flagged.
_notes: Self-harm and grooming are review triggers for a caring adult or a human moderator, not automatic actions. See docs/KIDS.md for the per-tag calibration table.
